mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_price (model, input_per_million, output_per_million, updated_at) VALUES (#{model}, #{inputPerMillion}, #{outputPerMillion}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (model) DO UPDATE SET input_per_million = EXCLUDED.input_per_million, output_per_million = EXCLUDED.output_per_million, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
